lines.value: case(in.zus_stage, 'zbieg', 0, 'start', 0, 'preferential', p.zus.base_preferential, 'maly_plus', min(p.zus.base_full, max(p.zus.base_preferential, grosze(p.zus.maly_plus_share * in.maly_plus_income / in.maly_plus_days * 30))), 'full', p.zus.base_full)
grosze(p.pit.car_mixed_share * (v('car_net', in.business) + v('car_vat', in.business) - if(in.vat_payer, grosze(p.vat.car_mixed_share * v('car_vat', in.business)), 0)))
v('costs', in.business) + if(in.vat_payer, 0, v('costs_vat', in.business)) + v('car.pit')

case(in.form, 'skala', grosze(max(p.health.minimum, v('health.base') * p.health.rate)), 'liniowy', grosze(max(p.health.minimum, v('health.base') * p.health.rate_linear)), 'ryczalt', grosze(grosze(p.health.ryczalt_wage * band(p.health.ryczalt_tiers, if(in.ryczalt_tier = 'last_year', in.last_year_revenue, ytd('revenue', in.business) - ytd('zus.social')))) * p.health.rate))

lines.value: case(in.form, 'skala', zl(max(0, ytd('income'))), 'liniowy', zl(max(0, ytd('income') - min(ytd('health'), p.health.linear_limit))), 'ryczalt', zl(max(0, ytd('revenue', in.business) - ytd('zus.social') - p.pit.ryczalt_health_share * ytd('health'))))
case(in.form, 'skala', max(0, brackets(p.pit.scale, v('tax.base')) - p.pit.reduction), 'liniowy', p.pit.linear_rate * v('tax.base'), 'ryczalt', in.ryczalt_rate * v('tax.base'))
